title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated MagAttract v.1
author: Edel Sheerin

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer master mix containing the following components:

substeps.instruction: 200 µL Phosphate buffered solution (PBS)
20 µL Proteinase K
4 µL RNase A
150 µL Buffer AL

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare samples for lysis based on the sample type:

substeps.instruction: For cryoprepped samples: Transfer 25 mg cryogenically disrupted sample into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube and hold on dry ice. Add 374 µL of the lysis buffer master mix and homogenise by gently pipetting 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.

For PowerMashed samples (< 25 mg): Transfer sample into a 1.5 mL BioMasher II tube and add 374 µL lysis buffer. Disrupt using the Diagnocine PowerMasher II tissue disruptor and BioMasher pestle until no large pieces remain or further disruption is impossible. Transfer entire contents to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube using a wide-bore tip.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge sample tubes briefly and incubate on the heat block at 25 °C for 2 hours.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: While samples are lysing, label nine 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates and fill the required wells as follows:

substeps.instruction: Tip plate: 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Elution 2: 200 µL Buffer AE
Elution 1: 200 µL Buffer AE
NFW Wash: 500 µL Nuclease-Free Water
PE Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer PE
PE Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer PE
MW1 Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer MW1
MW1 Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer MW1
Sample plate: 15 µL Suspension G magnetic beads and 280 µL Buffer MB

steps.title: Transfer Lysate to Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Once lysis is complete, remove sample tubes from the heat block and briefly centrifuge to spin down. Using a wide bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, transfer lysate from the sample tubes to individual wells in the sample plate, avoiding the transfer of large debris.

steps.title: Run KingFisher Extraction
steps.instruction: Execute the automated extraction protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex:

substeps.instruction: Select the DNA extraction protocol from the protocol list and press the play button.
Load the filled plates onto the instrument following the on-screen instructions.
Remove the 'Tip Plate' when prompted by the instrument prior to loading the 'Sample Plate'.
Allow the protocol to run automatically (approximately 50 minutes).
Follow on-screen instructions to remove plates upon completion.

steps.title: Clean Eluates of Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Inspect elution plates for remaining magnetic beads. If beads are present (common in viscous samples):

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Place the tube on a magnetic rack for approximately 5 minutes to allow beads to migrate.
Collect the clear DNA eluate using a wide bore pipette tip.

steps.title: Recover and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Recover the DNA and store for future use:

substeps.instruction: Using a 200 µL multi-channel pipette and wide bore tips, pipette eluates from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes.
Pipette mix with wide bore tips to fully homogenise the DNA in the eluate.
Perform required QC and store the DNA at 4 °C.
